2) An initial incident summary within 72 hours specifying whether Redwood systems were involved and any model request logs that reference Clarity tenant IDs.
3) A secure channel for evidence exchange (SFTP/S3 presigned or JBOD + chain-of-custody) and named contact for forensic coordination.

Eliot — following up with a formal path and contract references from Redwood. We're looping in Jonas (Legal) to ensure any evidence transfer and timeline commitments are contract-aligned.

Quick summary of Redwood's proposed cadence (consistent with our standard DPA clauses):
- Acknowledgement: within 48 hours (completed).
- Preliminary incident summary: within 72 hours (we reaffirm target of 2027-08-31 11:00 PDT).
- Forensic handover: we can provide a segregated, time-limited S3 upload channel within 5 business days, conditional on an evidence-handling TOU or a limited POA.
- Full investigative report: target within 7 calendar days of confirmed scope, with continued updates as we gather object access logs, model request traces, and network telemetry.

Contract clarity and clauses: per our standard DPA (Section 6.2 — Notification & Cooperation) we are obligated to:
- Notify within the windows above for incidents affecting Customer Data.
- Cooperate with reasonable forensic requests and preserve relevant logs for at least 90 days post-incident unless otherwise agreed.
- Provide names of subprocessors that had programmatic access to identified export prefixes upon a signed request; we will not disclose subprocessor contracts but will provide contact points for preservation requests.

Cross-border transfer note: for EU-resident data, Redwood relies on SCCs embedded in our DPA and our subprocessors' contractual commitments. If Clarity requires additional mechanisms (local processing agreements or escrowed data handover within EU), please indicate and we will escalate to our Privacy team.

Next steps we propose:
1) Sign a short-form Evidence Handling TOU (we've attached a one-page PDF) to enable secure upload.
2) Stand up a private, invitation-only Slack channel for day-to-day coordination.
3) Redwood to deliver a subprocessor access list scoped to the export prefix within 48 business hours of the signed TOU.

If you prefer to proceed under a mutual non-disclosure + limited POA in lieu of the TOU, indicate that and we'll accept it subject to a quick legal review.

Attachments: SOC2-Audit-Log-Snippets.zip, Evidence_Handling_TOU_v1.pdf

Regards,
